verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents its own telephony path: the dev runner terminates telephony WebSockets, `python bot.py -t twilio -x your-name.ngrok.io` runs a bot against a carrier, and Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel and SIP are supported. The phone number itself must come from an external carrier, plus an ngrok tunnel. The 'under 5 minutes' quickstart only covers a browser agent, so first live phone call within an hour is not evidenced. Missing for 10: built-in phone number provisioning, a documented phone-call quickstart with a time-to-first-call claim, and hands-on corroboration of a first live call within an hour.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a working phone voice agent — prompt, voice, and phone number — and take my first live call within an hour

citations.quote: terminating telephony WebSockets, and serving a prebuilt UI to talk to your bot
the carrier (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, or your SIP provider) is calling your webhook to tell you there's an inbound call
